review:
Dawn of Kings is Hacksaw's take on the classic Book slot: 5x3, paylines, and a Book symbol that acts as both wild and scatter. Explorer Amy Dawn leads you through the temple, and three Books start Book of Dawn free spins, four start Triple Book of Dawn, and five also pay a 1,000x prize on top.

Pairing three Books with the Best of Bonus symbol gives you the Best of Book option, which plays both bonus types and keeps the better result. If you know traditional book games, you'll learn it immediately, but the triple-expanding-symbol bonus gives it more upside, up to 10,000x.
